units.source_text: 也许正是明天金阁将会遭到火劫吧。

en.t: Perhaps it is tomorrow that the Golden Pavilion will be consumed by fire.

units.source_text: 充满空间的那个形态将会丧失吧……

en.t: That form which filled the space will be lost...

units.source_text: 那时候，屋顶上的那只凤凰将会复苏为不死鸟而飞翔。

en.t: At that moment, the phoenix on the roof will revive as an immortal bird and fly away.

units.source_text: 被束缚在形态中的金阁将会轻飘飘地离开它的锚而出现在这里那里，

en.t: The Golden Pavilion, bound within its form, will drift lightly away from its anchor and appear here and there,

units.source_text: 漂泊在湖面上、黑暗的海潮上、透露微光荡漾在水面上……

en.t: wandering over the surface of the lake, over the dark tides of the sea, glimmering faintly as it wavers on the water...
